sources.quote: 8.3.6.1 Any change to a requirement stated on a customer drawing, including material and finish, needs written approval from Stellantis before the change is implemented.
Annex A: programs STL-Torino-27 and STL-Torino-31.
4. Finish: anodise type II, thickness 10 to 15 micrometres, black, per specification SPEC-FIN-12.

findings.why: BR-220 is a Stellantis part on program STL-Torino-27, which is listed in Annex A of the customer requirements. The effective drawing Rev C specifies anodise type II. Switching to a chromate conversion coat changes a finish requirement on the customer drawing. Clause 8.3.6.1 therefore requires written Stellantis approval before the change is implemented. No document in force already covers this change.
